first_build_goal: Make the sound-information tradeoff legible: revealing more cave must also visibly change predator risk.
Prove the deterministic Patrol/Hunt/ReturnToPatrol loop can support a complete Relic-out-and-back mission.

include.success: Relic collected and player returns to Entrance

rules.success_priority: Relic+Entrance success is resolved before Air=0 failure on that action

must_work.text: Loading a fixed mission restores its authored initial rule state.
must_work.check: debug_load_fixture('M1') exposes Entrance, starting Air/Clickers, initial reveal and authored predator state.

must_work.text: Invalid movement into an unrevealed tile changes nothing.
must_work.check: invalid debug_act(move) returns false and snapshot is unchanged.

must_work.text: Ping reveals radius3, costs one Air and uses hearing radius5.
must_work.check: M1 synthetic step compares Air/reveal/predator retarget after Ping.

must_work.text: Knock reveals radius5 and uses hearing radius8.
must_work.check: M1 route after Knock has expected reveal and Hunt state.

must_work.text: Clicker is a remote sound origin with range4 and correct costs.
must_work.check: M3 route action clicker(2,2) consumes one Clicker and one Air and Hunt targets 2,2.

must_work.text: Predator Hunt lasts at most three steps then deterministically ReturnToPatrol.
must_work.check: replay crosses Hunt expiry and compares mode/return target to reference.

must_work.text: Hide protects same-tile contact for one predator resolution only.
must_work.check: M2 authored route includes Hide and survives the protected resolution.

must_work.text: Relic pickup changes objective and returning to Entrance succeeds.
must_work.check: authored M1-M3 success routes end in result=success.

must_work.text: Contact and Air exhaustion are real failure states.
must_work.check: small loaded scenes force each failure and compare result.

must_work.text: Retry restores the complete authored mission rule state.
must_work.check: mutate state, retry, and compare snapshot to initial snapshot.
